integrity: The proof uses the printed equilibrium balances, positivity, monotonicity, and exact rational arithmetic. The packaged checker recomputes the numerical contradiction and reported-point residual.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns the equations and terminating-decimal parameter values as printed in Section 7.2.
It does not identify whether the discrepancy arose from simulation code, transcription, or a different parameterization.
It does not invalidate general local or Hopf calculations at parameter sets that actually possess a positive equilibrium.
title: A delay-independent exclusion criterion for the printed coexistence equilibrium
